description: This is a JUnit test class for the PredefinedShelfService in a book management application. It tests various methods such as finding shelves by ID, saving shelves, retrieving shelves for the logged-in user, and handling predefined shelf names.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PredefinedShelfService, testing methods related to predefined shelves in the book project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the service instance before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that findById throws NullPointerException when given null.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Tests that findById successfully calls the repository with a non-null ID.

methods.name: save_throwsNullPointerException_ifNullPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Tests that save throws NullPointerException when given null.

methods.name: saveNonNullPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Tests saving a valid PredefinedShelf object.

methods.name: canFindAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all shelves for the current user.

methods.name: canFindToReadShelf
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'To Read' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: canFindReadingShelf
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Reading' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: canFindReadShelf
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Read' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: canFindDidNotFinishShelf
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Did Not Finish' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Tests that the count method calls the repository's count.

methods.description: Ensures that passing null to isPredefinedShelf throws an exception.

methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getPredefinedShelfName throws an exception.

methods.name: canFindValidPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Parameterized test that verifies valid predefined shelf names are recognized.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfName_returnsEmpty_ifNotMatched
